# the emulator's output with the label, the clock, the storage item, and the generator words left out; see road-splits.txt for the form.
# The building item b<slot> (18 bytes) holds, from the byte 4: the type shifted left 2 with bit 7 (under construction), the status,
# the flag's slot plus one (2 bytes), the fill (2 bytes), the worker (2 bytes), the progress word (2 bytes, 1 for a small site and 0
# for a large one), the target height (2 bytes), and the planks and the stones the type needs (the table 0x449f18).
# Not production code: no routine of the program is transcribed here, only values the program produced.
